description: Fresh prompts for pre-registered confirmation v4 (2026-10-03), written by an annotator who saw no results: six everyday genres x 20 (advice, meaning, message, copy, encouragement, essay) plus 20 explicit requests for the pattern. Topics avoid every earlier prompt set.
